newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh PM congratulates Pakistan's Sharif.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM congratulates Pakistan's Sharif.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina congratulated Pakistan Prime Minister-elect Nawaz Sharif on Friday, saying she expects him to lead his country to a "greater height."
"I am delighted to learn about the landslide victory of your party both in national and provincial assembly elections," Hasina, now visiting the United States, said in a message to Sharif.

"Let me extend my sincere and hearty felicitations to you on the massive mandate given to you by the people of Pakistan," the official BSS news agency quoted Hasina as telling the Pakistan Muslim League leader.
The PML defeated Pakistan People's Party of ousted Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto by a wide margin in elections held on Monday, and is set to form a new government.
Hasina also wished Sharif strength to "lead the brotherly nation to a greater height."
Bangladesh, formerly East Pakistan, broke away following a nine-month war in 1971, with help from India.
All three countries are now members of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC), which also groups Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal and Sri Lanka.
